description: Waves Corporation Limited, originally Waves Singer Pakistan Limited, is a Pakistani home-appliance manufacturer founded in 1971, when it introduced the country's first deep freezer. It was renamed following a 2017 merger with Cool Industries and sells under the slogan 'Naam hi Kafi hai'.
headOffice: 9 KM Multan Road, Hanjarwal, Lahore, Pakistan
